_about: Official save locations for individual games, keys starting with 'g'.
Sharded by the first character of match_value so placement is mechanical: no
judgement call about which file a game belongs in. A test enforces it.
layout 'official' means these describe where the game AS SHIPPED writes saves,
which is the only per-game claim allowed to bind automatically (decision table
row 5). Do not put an engine, OS or community location here.
